source.title: Lurgan Mail, 19 May 1961, p. 3 ("No contests in rural areas")
source.publisher: Lurgan Mail (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: the no-contests report read in the Lurgan Mail of 19 May 1961.

note: Triennial election of Moira Rural District Council, polled Thursday 1 June 1961. There was no contest in any division; the Lurgan Mail prints the representative returned for each of the seven divisions. Returned unopposed. Returned unopposed.
